statement.description:
Little Dima misbehaved during a math lesson a lot and the nasty teacher Mr. Pickles gave him the following problem as a punishment.

Find all integer solutions $ x $ $ (0<x<10^{9}) $ of the equation:

 $ x=b·s(x)^{a}+c, $ where $ a $ , $ b $ , $ c $ are some predetermined constant values and function $ s(x) $ determines the sum of all digits in the decimal representation of number $ x $ .

The teacher gives this problem to Dima for each lesson. He changes only the parameters of the equation: $ a $ , $ b $ , $ c $ . Dima got sick of getting bad marks and he asks you to help him solve this challenging problem.
statement.formatI: The first line contains three space-separated integers: $ a,b,c $ $ (1<=a<=5; 1<=b<=10000; -10000<=c<=10000) $ .
statement.formatO: Print integer $ n $ — the number of the solutions that you've found. Next print $ n $ integers in the increasing order — the solutions of the given equation. Print only integer solutions that are larger than zero and strictly less than $ 10^{9} $ .

translation.description:
小 Dima 在数学课上特别顽皮，坏老师 Mr. Pickles 就给了他这样一道题作为惩罚。

请找出满足下列方程的所有整数解 $x$，其中 $0 < x < 10^{9}$：

$$
x = b \cdot s(x)^a + c
$$

其中 $a$、$b$、$c$ 是给定的常数，函数 $s(x)$ 表示 $x$ 的十进制表示下各位数字之和。

每节课老师都会再次出这道题，只是改变方程的参数 $a$、$b$、$c$。Dima 厌倦了差评，想请你来帮他解决这个棘手的问题。
translation.formatI: 输入共一行，包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $a, b, c$，满足 $1 \leq a \leq 5$，$1 \leq b \leq 10000$，$-10000 \leq c \leq 10000$。
translation.formatO: 输出一行一个整数 $n$，表示找到所有解的个数。接下来一行输出所有满足条件的解（严格大于零且小于 $10^9$ 的整数解），按递增顺序输出，数之间用空格隔开。
